title: CSV header quotes cannot split a caption into a formula field

criteria.given: a FoodMart query has a calculated measure whose caption contains a quote, comma and formula prefix
criteria.then: CSV export doubles the caption's quotes, keeping the formula text inside its original header field

steps.name: execute the calculated-member query from issue 2544

json.name: acceptance-2544
json.mdx: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[x","=HYPERLINK(""http://127.0.0.1:1/x"",""click"")] AS 1 SELECT {[Measures].[Unit Sales], [Measures].[x","=HYPERLINK(""http://127.0.0.1:1/x"",""click"")]} ON COLUMNS, {[Gender].[Gender].Members} ON ROWS FROM [Sales]

steps.name: CSV header keeps the formula-looking text inside its quoted field
